experiment: ML Lab - Rules vs ML transaction risk classification
observations: The ML classifier achieved higher overall accuracy than the deterministic rules.
The ML classifier performed substantially worse on High-risk recall despite its higher overall accuracy.
The majority Medium class represented 68% of the evaluation dataset.
A naive always-Medium classifier would achieve 68% accuracy.
The ML classifier introduced additional inference latency compared with deterministic rules.
Deterministic rules exhibited explicit behavior changes around manually defined thresholds.
The edge-case experiment demonstrates behavioral differences but does not establish which classifier is correct because the edge cases do not have ground-truth labels.
